name: TIE/ad starfighter
description: The TIE/ad starfighter, simply known as the TIE Advanced, TIE/Ad or T/A, was the culmination of a series of starfighter designs first explored with Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1. To avoid confusion with Lord Vader's personal craft, it was known better by its nickname TIE Avenger.

data.name: TIE/ad starfighter
data.engine: SFS P-sx7.4 Twin ion engines (rated 230 KTU)
data.shield_gen: Forward/Rear projecting Novaldex deflector shield generators (rated 40 SBD)
data.hull: Titanium hull with Quadanium steel solar panels (rated 14 RU)
